name: tabularium
description: Venue-qualified credit-event releases rebuilt from preserved source records.

interface.shortDescription: Venue-qualified credit-event releases rebuilt from preserved source records.
interface.longDescription: Tabularium turns preserved Goldfinch, Euler v1 and Euler V2 credit records into deterministic canonical JSONL without discarding source meaning or native records. It also rebuilds a non-canonical Compound v3 Phase 0 execution witness from a verified Alexandria release. Offline verification confines paths and rebuilds the expected event or witness bytes rather than trusting row claims.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $tabularium to build or verify a source-bound Goldfinch, Euler v1 or Euler V2 credit-event release, or rebuild a Compound v3 Phase 0 witness offline.
